facts.fact: The Civil Registry Act 2011 makes the General Administration of the Civil Registry of the Ministry of Interior responsible for all civil registry activities, with a state administration and a centre in each locality or administrative unit under it, and defines the registry of births, deaths and other civil-status incidents as a paper or automated record.
